link.q: How do I link a phone to the business?
link.a: On the new phone open the app and choose “Link this phone with a code”: you will see a short code. Then, in this panel, go to Team → Phones and type that code. The phone is linked and cashiers sign in with their PIN.

offline.q: What happens if the internet goes down?
offline.a: Nothing stops: the app keeps selling, recording credit sales and expenses, and saves everything on the phone. When the connection returns, whatever is pending is sent by itself, exactly once. Reports on this website catch up when the phones finish syncing.

closing.q: How does the daily close work?
closing.a: The close is automatic: nobody opens or closes anything. Each business day runs from one day's cutoff time (02:00 by default) to the next, so what is sold at 1 a.m. counts for the previous day, and "yesterday" is yesterday 02:00 to today 02:00. In Daily close you see, per day, sales by payment method, expenses, withdrawals and the expected cash = cash sales + cash credit payments + cash in − drawer expenses − withdrawals. Transfers, card and credit do not go in the drawer.

import.q: How do I import my products from a file?
import.a: In Inventory choose “Import CSV”. The file has one row per product with columns such as name, code, price, cost, unit, category and stock. First you see a preview of what would be created or updated, without saving anything; then you confirm. If you import again, what already exists is updated and not duplicated.
